key.name: library-enabled
key.description: Start the built-in peer-to-peer node with the app

key.name: library-name
key.summary: Name shown next to shared songs

key.name: library-peers
key.description: Addresses (host:port) of nodes to search in addition to those found in the DHT, for example friends on the same network

key.name: game-mode
key.description: Temporarily reduce P2P traffic and speculative work when a game is detected. Restore the user's limits after the game exits.

key.name: game-mode-force
key.summary: Keep game mode active without automatic detection
key.description: Apply reduced activity while Game Mode is enabled, even when the platform cannot recognize the game.

key.name: library-upload-limit
key.description: 0 means no limit. Only applies with a download limit, and is raised to at least a seventh of it

key.name: library-join-at-start
key.summary: Whether to join the network when the app starts
key.description: "auto" joins on computers and not on phones and tablets, where it costs battery and mobile data

key.name: library-rules-seen
key.summary: Whether the rules of sharing music were shown
key.description: They are shown once, the first time the app starts

key.name: library-only-protected
key.summary: Join the network only through a VPN
key.description: Leaves the network as soon as the connection stops going through a VPN, and joins again when it does

key.name: library-unliked-action
key.summary: What happens to a song taken out of the library
key.description: "move" saves it to the unliked songs folder, "delete" removes it from this computer (own files go to the trash)

key.name: library-unliked-folder
key.summary: Where songs taken out of the library are moved
key.description: Empty means "Unliked" in the music folder

key.name: accent-color
key.summary: Custom accent color in hexadecimal RGB

key.name: popular-metadata
key.summary: Automatically choose covers and lyrics shared by the most peers

key.name: missing-cover
key.summary: Image shown for songs without cover art

key.name: missing-cover-image
key.summary: Saved custom image for songs without cover art
